title: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, D
description: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Denmark Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Denmark. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English. The programme An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC. You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real. What you will work on Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. What you bring Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design. Useful but not essential: Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry. How to respond Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours. title: Remote Part-Time Executive Assistant
description: About FreedUp FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. About the role We’re looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to support a US-based real estate investor and operator. He owns and operates apartment buildings, manages them in-house with his own staff, and has a development project underway. His work spans acquisitions, property analysis, financing, lenders, lawyers, insurance claims, accounting and tenant escalations. His staff handles day-to-day property issues, and he steps in when things escalate. His inbox and calendar are the bottleneck. It requires excellent written communication, sound judgment and complete discretion. Compensation: 600 to 800 USD per month (depends on experience) Location: Remote, Philippines Job Type: Part-time What you'll do Email triage and responsiveness (main priority) Review all incoming email daily, then sort, prioritize and act on it. Respond directly to routine and administrative emails on his behalf, in his voice. Draft replies for messages that need his input or approval. Track open threads and follow up so nothing falls through the cracks. Judgment-based routing Decide what’s urgent, what goes straight to him, and what goes to his staff with him cc’d. Learn his key contacts (lenders, lawyers, brokers, insurers, accountants, staff) and how each should be handled. Flag time-sensitive items, such as financing deadlines, legal matters and insurance claims, before they become problems. Calendar and scheduling Set up and manage his calendar from scratch, including a booking link and scheduling rules. description: 这个职位为何存在？ 随着平台全景化业务的快速扩张，多语言文本、图片等场景下的欺诈引流、黑灰、产对抗形式日益严峻。该职位旨在建立一道坚固的交易所社交内容安全防线。 解决什么问题： 解决多语种多产品线生态下，传统风控手段对复杂欺诈变体、多模态（图文结合）违规行为（特别是引流）识别率低、对抗滞后的问题。补全目前风控团队缺失的内容风控能力板块，赋能交易所核心业务。 为什么现在需要它： 目前不法用户通过平台提供的社交功能大肆散播引流、欺诈图文，已经严重负面影响到C2C、代理、增长等核心业务，且风控团队内部暂时缺少内容风控领域人才和技术储备，急需有内容对抗经验的专家进来建设体系化的内容治理能力。 核心职责（3-5条） 1、构建全球多语言、多场景下的内容安全策略矩阵，针对欺诈、引流等违规行为搭建事前防御、事中监控、事后治理的全链路体系。 2、主导黑词库、黑图库等风控基础设施建设，推进文本与图片融合的多模态内容安全识别体系落地。 3、驱动多语言NLP模型及多模态融合模型的应用与高频迭代，深度联动算法团队，将前沿AI/Agent技术转化为实际的风控生产力。 4、建立可量化的内容安全效果评估体系，对风控核心指标进行深度拆解与数据漏斗分析，确保策略的精准度与召回率。 理想候选人是什么样的？ 1、具备敏锐的嗅觉与死磕到底的对抗精神： 对海内外社交生态中的违规变体有天然的警惕性，享受与黑灰、产博弈的过程，能从微弱的异常数据中揪出系统性风险。 2、拥有自驱型的“破局者”思维： 不满足于现成规则，面对小语种对抗等模糊、复杂的场景，能够主动拥抱AI Agent等新工具，自发寻找技术边界来拆解难题。 3、具备出色的跨界协同力： 既懂业务策略又能与研发“讲同一种语言”，能平衡风控效果与业务打扰 吸引人的亮点 1、真正的全景化视野与前沿AI实战场景： 你将直接操盘头部交易所的核心安全命脉，亲手将经典内容风控体系、AI Agent及多模态大模型推向千万级用户的实战对抗一线，并带来可量化的业务价值，而非做单纯的规则修补。 2、从0到1构建内容风控体系的绝对主导权： 团队氛围自驱且技术自豪感，你将主导多模态体系与核心库的搭建，你的每一个策略都将直接定义产品的安全边界。开放的行业/背景国际化互联网平台（出海社交/Live/社区）、跨境电商、交易所、反欺诈/内容安全服务商。 Originally posted on Himalayas

description: 【公司简介】 我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。 【岗位职责】 一、行情与实时数据系统 1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。 2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。 3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。 二、链上数据中台建设 1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。 2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。 3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。 4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。 【任职要求】 一、技术基础 1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳 Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。 Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。 2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。 3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。 4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。 5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。 6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。 7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。 8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。 具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。 二、AI 工程能力 1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。 2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。 3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。 【加分项】 1.有大数据实时与离线计算经验（Flink、Spark、Storm 等），熟悉 Lambda / Kappa 架构。 2.有 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）池子状态维护、价格计算、聚合行情相关经验。 3.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、抢跑保护等相关经验。 4.有时序数据库（如 TimescaleDB、Druid、ClickHouse）在行情场景下的落地经验。 5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。 6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。 Originally posted on Himalayas

description: 关于公司 我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球顶级交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。 我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中如鱼得水的优秀人才。我们正在构建下一代互联网的金融基础设施——我们正在寻找杰出的专业人士加入我们，共同塑造这一未来。 关于这个方向 这块业务覆盖合约跟单、CFD 跟单、美股实盘跟单，以及现货网格、马丁策略、期限套利等机器人业务，同时正在探索 AI 对话策略方向。这不是一个维护功能列表的岗位。我们需要一个真正理解交易行为、能在产品复杂度和用户理解之间找到平衡点的人。 你会负责什么 1、深入研究新手、进阶、和专业用户如何在跟单、机器人和自建策略之间做选择，并将洞察转化为产品决策 2、与工程、量化研究、AI、风控、设计、运营等团队协同，澄清需求取舍，持续推动产品高质量上线 3、持续追踪跟单交易、量化工具和 AI 投资类产品的前沿动态，形成自己的判断，而不是机械复制功能 4、围绕量化策略方向，推动经典机器人策略优化、策略参数可理解性设计、AI 策略探索、策略表现与归因展示等功能落地 5、围绕跟单交易方向，优化交易员发现与信任体系、跟单配置与风控体验、多品类跟单建设、仓位透明度与信任信号设计 我们希望你具备 1、对交易行为和金融产品有真实兴趣，进入复杂领域时能快速找到核心逻辑，而不是停留在表面功能 2、有较强的独立驱动力；需求不清晰时，你会主动定义目标、厘清路径，而不是等待被推动 3、能理解风险决策场景下的用户心理：为什么用户会选择某个交易员、中途关掉机器人、调整参数或彻底失去信任 4、有清晰的产品判断力：一个跟单界面或策略配置页面有没有把复杂信息讲清楚、风险展示是否会造成误导，你能看出来 5、具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能在技术、量化研究、风控和业务之间建立共识，而不只是在中间传话 加分项 1、有跟单交易、社交交易（Social Trading）、交易机器人或量化平台类产品的完整项目经验 2、对跟单或量化策略其中一个方向的交易工具有浓厚兴趣，是主流平台产品的重度用户 3、有 AI 产品方向的思考或经验，理解自然语言交互如何与专业金融工具结合 4、有用户研究、数据分析或 A/B 实验经验，能将行为数据转化为产品洞察 Originally posted on Himalayas

description: 【岗位职责】 一、交易聚合与路由 1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。 2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。 3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。 二、询价与做市商接入 1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。 2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。 3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。 三、高并发与低延迟 1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。 2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。 【任职要求】 一、技术基础 1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。 2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。 3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。 具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。 4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。 5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。 熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。 6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。 7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。 8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。 9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。 二、AI 工程能力 1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。 2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。 3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。 【加分项】 1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。 2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。 3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。 4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。 5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。 Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About the Role Join a lean team at an early-stage AI-driven biotech company, combining computational protein design with hands-on experimental work. Operate and refine a biological design inference platform, analyzing usage patterns and diagnosing user behavior. Write, debug, and operate production protocols for liquid-handling robots and plate automation. Design and run BLI and SPR assays, fit kinetic curves, conduct quality control, and troubleshoot experimental failure modes. Develop robust protocols for cloud labs and manage internal screening instrumentation. Connect receptor biology, protein structure, scoring, and model outputs to practical experimental workflows. Design sequences, measure their kinetics, use results to update models, and iterate toward improved candidates. What We're Looking For 3 to 11 years of relevant experience, including hands-on wet-lab work and experience across biology, bioinformatics, and machine learning. Experience building or operating protein or biological models, such as discrete diffusion models, protein language models, or structure prediction systems, in an experimental feedback loop. Practical experience with tools such as ESM, ProtT5, RFdiffusion, BindCraft, or equivalent, applied to real protein design workflows. Hands-on experience writing and debugging liquid-handler protocols and personally fitting BLI or SPR kinetic curves end to end. Proficiency with Python or equivalent scripting for robot automation and kinetic data analysis. Knowledge of receptor biology, protein structure, and scoring, with the ability to diagnose why computational predictions may not match experimental results. Experience in biotech or life sciences software customer success, solutions engineering, or a similar customer-facing operator role, including user conversion and varied purchasing processes. Ability to conduct personalized scientific outreach and experience operating inference systems at scale or refining model architectures. Compensation & Benefits Consulting engagement: $3,000 to $5,000 per month. Full-time conversion base salary: $80,000 to $200,000 annually, depending on experience, with equity and deal-contingent upside. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Hybrid in New York, United States, with increased on-site presence expected as internal screening operations are established. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet's infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet's platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.

Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams' success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don't own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.

title: Developer Community Lead
description: About RhymeQ RhymeQ is on a mission to make quantum programmable for every developer. Today, developing quantum software often requires deep physics expertise and code tailored to specific hardware. We’re removing these barriers so developers can focus on solving problems. Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, we bring together an international team with an open mindset, an energetic team spirit, and a shared drive to build something that matters. We value initiative, ownership, and collaboration, giving everyone the space to contribute ideas, take responsibility, and help shape the future of quantum programming. Your role As our Developer Community Lead, you will help developers discover, write their first quantum program, and keep building. Your goal is to turn early interest into an active community where developers learn from one another, share projects, and contribute to the product’s development. You will combine technical education, community building, and developer outreach. Working closely with our founders and engineering team, you will shape the community experience and grow the community internationally to our target size. What you will do Grow an active developer community: Build relationships with universities, programming communities, quantum organizations, and event organizers to attract developers to RHYME. Help newcomers succeed: Create a clear onboarding journey, from registration and installation to running and sharing a first quantum program. Build reasons to return: Organize onboarding cohorts, office hours, coding challenges, and hackathons that encourage continued learning and participation. Create useful technical content: Develop tutorials, sample projects, livestreams, posts, and talks that make quantum programming approachable. Support community contributions: Encourage developers to share their work, answer questions, and help others. Identify and support potential community ambassadors. Connect developers with the product team: Turn questions, feedback, and recurring problems into clear recommendations for the compiler, tooling, and documentation. Measure what works: Track acquisition, activation, retention, and contributions, and use the results to improve community programs. What you bring Bachelor’s in computer science, PhD is preferred. Over 2 years of experience growing a developer community for a technical product, with results you can demonstrate through active users, downloads, contributors, event participation, or other relevant measures. Practical Python skills. You can run code examples, lead a live tutorial, and help a newcomer troubleshoot their setup. The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and make learning engaging, whether in writing, on camera, or on stage. Strong written and spoken English and confidence working with an international audience. A self-driven approach: you can set priorities, organize programs, deliver them, and learn from the results. An open, supportive communication style
